title: Metaphors Matter: Disaster Myths, Media Frames, and Katrina (Tierney, Bevc & Kuligowski)
why: [disaster sociology (myths × media frames)] Claim: Decades of field research show popular “disaster myths” (panic, widespread looting, social breakdown, passive victims) are largely false — survivors tend toward prosocial behavior.
